description: System started (rising edge), logged in SYS Events with BAT SOC or ENG Coolant temp.

activating: PWR System started AND ((Joystick plugged md45 AND not(CFG Has_MD45)) OR (CFG Is_Cab AND not(CFG Has_MD410)) OR (Joystick plugged md3 AND not(CFG Has_MD3)))

description: Battery error (rising edge), logged with BAT Error raw code.

Isolation below threshold (rising edge), logged with BAT Isolation.
Ground fault (rising edge).
Battery communication lost while the system runs.

description: Cell imbalance above threshold for 60 s, logged with BAT Cell V delta.
activating: BAT Cell V delta > LOG Cell delta threshold

description: Cell imbalance threshold for the Cell imbalance event.
Battery full (rising edge), logged with BAT SOC.
Charge started, logged with CHG Mains voltage.
Charge finished normally, logged with the energy of the charge.
Charge aborted, logged with CHG Error raw code.
Charger error (rising edge), logged with CHG Error raw code.
M1 inverter error, logged with DRV M1 error raw code.
M2 inverter error, logged with DRV M2 error raw code.
M3 pump inverter error, logged with PMP error raw code.
